tools.description: Liveness check. Returns ok and version. Free, no key.
tools.name: health_check

tools.description: List everything this server covers: every money_fact fact_key with an example question, and every scheme_lookup country. Free (nothing on this server is billed); call first if unsure whether a fact is covered.
tools.name: pricing_list

tools.description: Get an official, dated personal-finance limit: deposit insurance (FDIC, FSCS, CDIC, AU FCS, NZ DCS) or contribution limits and allowances (UK ISA, Lifetime ISA, Junior ISA, pension annual allowance, Personal Savings Allowance; US 401k + catch-ups, IRA, Roth IRA, HSA; Canada TFSA, RRSP, FHSA; Australia super concessional/non-concessional caps; NZ KiwiSaver government contribution). Use instead of memory when a user asks "how much is protected" or "how much can I contribute". Pass q as plain English ("fdic limit joint account", "isa allowance") or a fact_key from pricing_list. Returns fact, source {name,url}, as_of, jurisdiction, cite. Free, no key. Unknown -> not_in_catalog (never guesses).

q.description: Plain-English question or fact_key, e.g. "fscs deposit protection limit" or "us_401k_limit_2026".

tools.name: money_fact

tools.description: Identify a country's deposit-insurance scheme and its headline coverage (US FDIC, UK FSCS, CA CDIC, AU FCS, NZ DCS) with the regulator's URL and as_of date. country accepts ISO codes or names: US/USA, UK/GB, CA, AU, NZ. Free, no key.

country.description: Country code or name: US/USA, UK/GB, CA, AU, NZ (e.g. "GB", "Canada").

tools.name: scheme_lookup

tools.description: Answer cross-border money questions: deposit protection for non-residents, which schemes cover accounts held across borders. Returns sourced scheme information for both countries (from_country and to_country) with official regulator URLs and as_of dates. Covers US, UK, CA, AU, NZ. Free, no key. Unknown scenarios return not_in_catalog (never invents fees, FX rates, or coverage details).

from_country.description: Origin country code: US, UK, CA, AU, or NZ (e.g. "US" for US resident).

to_country.description: Destination country code: US, UK, CA, AU, or NZ (e.g. "UK" for UK bank account).

tools.name: cross_border_check
